strengths: Clear problem statement with concrete quantitative motivation (perplexity explosion from 9.31 to 1400+ at 64K tokens)
Proposes a data-free method that is practically useful when calibration data is unavailable
Mechanism analysis linking eigenvalue extremes to input-dependent ∆t dynamics adds scientific depth
Honest benchmarking against both calibrated and uncalibrated baselines
weaknesses: PPL@64K of 11.44 is substantially worse than the calibrated baseline (4.72), making the method a fallback rather than a competitive solution
The introduction does not discuss downstream task performance—perplexity alone may not capture practical utility
No discussion of computational overhead of computing the transition spectrum or sensitivity to the percentile hyperparameter q
Scope is limited to Mamba/Mamba2; generalizability to other SSM architectures is unclear
The 17.5% channel modification figure is presented as if it is a result of the method, but it reads like a tuned hyperparameter outcome—this is not adequately contextualized

ai_detection.reasoning: The introduction follows a highly formulaic structure: one paragraph establishing the problem, one surveying prior work with precise numbers, one proposing the solution, and a canonical 3-bullet contribution list. The prose is uniformly technical and declarative with no varied sentence rhythm, hedging, or narrative texture typical of human academic writing. The contribution bullets are parallel and self-contained in a way characteristic of LLM-generated text.
